# netbox_service (Resource)

Manages a NetBox application service (`/api/ipam/services/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_manufacturer" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_type" "example" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.example.id
  model           = "example"
  slug            = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device_role" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_site" "example" {
  name = "example"
  slug = "example"
}
resource "netbox_device" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.example.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.example.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.example.id
}
resource "netbox_service" "example" {
  parent_object_type = "dcim.device"
  parent_object_id   = netbox_device.example.id
  name               = "example"
  port_mappings      = ["tcp/443"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.
- `parent_object_id` (Number) Parent Object Id.
- `parent_object_type` (String) Parent Object Type.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `ipaddress_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the assigned Ipaddres (`netbox_ip_address`). Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `port_mappings` (Set of String) Port Mappings. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_service can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_service.example 123
```
